data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew 'avar' meaning 'father' and 'ron' meaning 'bear'. Avron may be interpreted as the 'father of a bear' or 'bear-father'. In the Old Testament, Avram (Avron's Hebrew variant) is the name of a patriarch who is called Abram in the Old Testament and Abraham in the New Testament. He is considered the founder of the Jewish people.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength and leadership
data.etymology: Avron belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of a bear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avron total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
